title: Which shelter has space

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Which shelter still has space tonight?

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Are you in the water now?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: No. We are dry. We just want a place if the rain comes back.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Sop Prap District, Lampang. We can see the invented green gate.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Two adults. We have a motorbike and we can travel.
